blocks.title: Intensity
blocks.text: Intensity aage barhti (progressive) wave ke phailao ki simt mein fi unit raqbe fi unit waqt muntaqil hone wali energy ki miqdar hai. Yeh wave ki power ka paimana hai, aam taur par I se zahir ki jati hai, aur watts per square metre (W m^-2) mein napi jati hai.

Progressive ya chalti hui wave woh hai jo medium mein ek mustaqil simt mein chalti hai aur energy ek nuqte se doosre tak muntaqil karti hai; yeh aage barhti hai, stationary ya standing wave ke ulat. Progressive waves ki misalein pani ki waves, sound waves aur light waves hain. Tareef ke mutabiq wave ki intensity I = E/(A x t) = (E/t)/A, ya I = P/A (kyunke E/t = P), jahan I intensity W m^-2 mein, E energy joules mein, t waqt seconds mein, A raqba aur P power watts mein hai.

Mechanical waves, jaise sound waves, pani ki waves ya vibrate karte taar par waves, mein energy medium ke zarron ki kinetic energy aur potential energy ki shakal mein jama hoti hai. Kitni energy jama hai yeh zarron ke mean position se displacement (amplitude) par munhasir hai; lihaza waves ki intensity I amplitude ke murabbe ke tanasub mein hai: I, A^2 ke tanasub mein, ya I = k A^2 ... (7.13). Yahan k tanasub ka constant hai aur wave aur medium ki tabai khusoosiyat par munhasir hai. Chalti wave ki frequency aur amplitude ek doosre se azaad hain; isi liye aap gaane ki awaz (volume) barha sakte hain (amplitude barha kar) baghair us ki pitch badle, jo frequency par munhasir hai (Tidbits). Sound khala mein nahi chal sakti, kyunke wahan sound wave muntaqil karne wale zarre nahi (Tidbits).

blocks.title: Example 7.8
blocks.text: (a) Ek wave ki source se 3.0 m faasle par intensity 0.5 W m^-2 hai. Wave ki power kya hai? (b) Do progressive waves ki intensities 0.5 W m^-2 aur 0.25 W m^-2 hain; kul intensity nikalein. Hal: (a) I = 0.5 W m^-2, r = 3.0 m, P = ?. Chunke I = P/A = P/(4 pi r^2), 0.5 = P/(4 x 3.14 x (3.0)^2), to P = 0.5 x 113.04 = 56.52 W. (b) I1 = 0.5 W m^-2, I2 = 0.25 W m^-2, I = I1 + I2 = 0.5 + 0.25 = 0.75 W m^-2.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yeh line 'P = 0.51 x 13.04' chhapi hai. Sahi line P = 0.5 x 113.04 hai, kyunke 4 x 3.14 x (3.0)^2 = 113.04; is ka jawab 56.52 W hai, jo kitab ne bhi diya hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.9
blocks.text: Ek speaker 50 W power ki sound waves nikalta hai. Agar sound waves har simt mein barabar phailein aur speaker se 5 m faasle par intensity napi jaye, to us faasle par kurre ka raqba taqreeban 314 m^2 hone par intensity kya hai? Hal: P = 50 W, A = 314 m^2; intensity = power/raqba, I = P/A = 50 W / 314 m^2, taqreeban 0.159 W m^-2.

blocks.prompt: Agar wave ka amplitude teen guna ho jaye to us ki energy kitni barhti hai (MCQ 7.8)? Agar A = 2 m par I = 16 W m^-2 ho to k nikalein; agar I = 25 W m^-2 aur k = 5 W m^-4 ho to A nikalein. 500 W radio antenna: 10 km door intensity kya hai (numerical 7.6, 7.8)?
blocks.explanation: I, A^2 ke tanasub mein hai, to amplitude teen guna karne se energy 9 guna hoti hai. k = I/A^2 = 16/4 = 4 W m^-4; A = sqrt(I/k) = sqrt(25/5) = 2.24 m. I = P/(4 pi r^2) = 500/(4 x 3.14 x (10^4)^2) = 500/1.26 x 10^9 = 4 x 10^-7 W m^-2.

items: Intensity: progressive wave ki simt mein fi unit raqba fi unit waqt energy, W m^-2: I = E/(A t) = P/A; nuqtai source ke liye A = 4 pi r^2. I = k A^2 (7.13): energy amplitude ke murabbe ke saath barhti hai; amplitude (volume) aur frequency (pitch) azaad hain. Misalein: 56.52 W; 0.75 W m^-2; 0.159 W m^-2.
